name: It leaves the lights be
notes: Played by FS47Attention (S47Attention.cpp, N1110) when a visit finds the player inside with power: it holds, and goes.

beats.text: At {clock} something came right over the station and stayed there while the mains were out. The lamps stayed on, I stayed inside, and after a while it went.
It lost interest. Better stay away from those lights for a few days.
